recentItems.title: Vidya Balan, Varun Dhawan, And Janhvi Kapoor On The Patriarchal Behaviour Of The Industry
recentItems.description:
The Film Companion Actors’ Adda 2022 saw the biggest lineup of pan-India actors from Rishab Shetty, Anil Kapoor, Vidya Balan, Janhvi Kapoor, Dulquer Salmaan, Ayushmann Khurrana, Vijay Varma, Sheeba Chadha to Rajkummar Rao sit across from Anupama Chopra to discuss the year that was, break down scenes from their films that terrified them and performances from the year that made them jealous.

recentItems.title: Ajay Devgn On The Unity In The Film Industry | Film Companion Express
recentItems.description:
In this session of FC Front Row, actor-producer-director Ajay Devgn talks to Anupama Chopra about negotiating success on his terms, the need for the Hindi film industry to be more unified and being a spontaneous actor. He also talks about his upcoming film Runway 34, where he gets to direct Amitabh Bachchan. Also, a quick update about Singham 3.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Kiara Advani On Her Experience Of Working On Game Changer | Film Companion Express
recentItems.description:
Kiara Advani speaks to Anupama Chopra about making her international film festival debut with the 77th edition of Cannes. The actor, who will represent India at the Women in Cinema Gala Dinner, opens up about the importance of gender representation in filmmaking, her desire to blend content and commerce, and leaving her mark on the industry. Advani also speaks about her role S. Shankar’s upcoming Telugu film Game Changer, how “Jaragandi” was the hardest song she’s ever shot, and trusting her instinct when it comes to picking her projects.

recentItems.title: Kani Kusruti On All We Imagine As Light And The Process Of Preparing For It | Film Companion Express
recentItems.description:
The cast of Payal Kapadia’s All We Imagine as Light speaks to Anupama Chopra about their film. Kani Kusruti talks about her journey to getting the part, and how she was initially supposed to play the role of Divya Prabha. Divya Prabha talks about the experience of working with a collaborative filmmaker like Kapadia. Chhaya Kadam, who felt like the part was written for her, talks about the attention to detail on set, and how she immersed herself in the life of her character. For Hridhoo Haroon, the acting workshops and shooting of All We Imagine as Light felt like an acting school, and how this was the project where he learnt the most.

#KaniKusruti #AllWeImagineAsLight

recentItems.title: Karthik Subbaraj On Jigarthanda DoubleX And Its Vision | Film Companion Express
recentItems.description:
The Film Companion Directors Adda 2023 had a great lineup of directors. They talked about their work and shared stories about the surprising ways their careers have gone and the emotional parts of making movies. They discussed how hard it is to make a film, how they choose actors, and what it's like to work alone as a filmmaker. They also talked about how movies deal with gender issues, how stories affect people who watch them, and how making movies has helped them grow personally.

recentItems.title: Imran Khan On His Upcoming Projects | Film Companion Express
recentItems.description:
In this exclusive conversation with Anupama Chopra, we see Imran Khan give his first interview, post his sabbatical. He talks about what these years were like, and how he put the focus on himself and his mental health. He delves deep into the reasons that led him to quitting the industry 9 years ago, and all that makes him want to still tell stories, from and to the heart. He shares his experiences of being overtly self-sufficient, and what kind of scripts he’s looking at now, in order to make a comeback on the big screen.

recentItems.title: Shahid Kapoor On Being A Star, And Also An Actor | Film Companion Express
recentItems.description:
In an interview with Anupama Chopra, Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon talk about the new Amit Joshi and Aradhana Sah directorial - Teri Baaton Mein Aisa Ulja Jiya. They discuss the discourse surrounding the title of the film, creating chemistry together and what it was like to dance together. The delve deep into the film’s plot and the future of AI as they see it and how the director duo has put in maximum effort to make the film sound and look technically sensible.
